title: PublishFileInput
description: Publish a file you made (HTML prototype, Markdown doc, PDF, text, JSON, CSV) as a project deliverable. The platform uploads it from your working directory and hosts it; people view it on the Deliverables page and their comments come back to you as messages. A directory with index.html is published as a small site (it may contain images and other assets). Pass deliverable_id to publish a new version of an earlier deliverable. Screenshots and images are not deliverables: a lone PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP is saved as an attachment in your thread's messages instead (no deliverable, cannot be a new version), and a lone SVG is refused. To put an image in a report, publish it in one directory with the report's index.html, or inline it in the HTML (an SVG can be written straight into the HTML); Markdown cannot show images. Cite an attachment (its id or URL) only in your written report.

path.description: File (or directory with index.html) inside your working directory, relative to it.

kind.description: design for prototypes and visual designs, doc for documents and specs; also slides, dashboard, board, data.

deliverable_id.description: An earlier deliverable of this project published with publish_file; the file becomes its next version.
